test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**, i.e., **Parliament**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correctly spelled word is **'Parliament'**.
 
• **Parliament** refers to the supreme legislative body in a country, especially in countries that follow the parliamentary system of governance.
 
• The other options are incorrectly spelled variations of the word.

Correct sentence usage:

 
• The **Parliament** will convene next week to discuss the new policy reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parliment:** Incorrect spelling of 'Parliament'.
 
• **Pailament:** Incorrect spelling of 'Parliament'.
 
• **Parlaiment:** Incorrect spelling of 'Parliament'.
 
• **Parliament:** The accurate spelling and correct answer.
